sections.title: Durable Tasks
sections.summary: Submit multi-step agent and robotics workflows that survive runtime failures. The coordination layer tracks a Write-Ahead Log, periodic checkpoints, and automatic failover to a healthy runtime.

endpoints.auth: Session cookie or igris_ API key
endpoints.description: Submit a new durable task (agent workflow, robotics workflow, or single inference).

endpoints.auth: Session cookie or igris_ API key
endpoints.description: Poll the status and last checkpoint of a durable task.

endpoints.auth: Session cookie or igris_ API key
endpoints.description: List recent durable tasks for the authenticated tenant.

endpoints.auth: Session cookie or igris_ API key
endpoints.description: Push a WAL checkpoint to the coordination layer. Called by the runtime after each checkpoint interval.

endpoints.auth: Session cookie or igris_ API key
endpoints.description: Mark a task as completed. Called by the runtime when all steps finish successfully.

endpoints.auth: Session cookie or igris_ API key
endpoints.description: Mark a task as failed with a reason. Called by the runtime on non-recoverable errors.
